'''Silvanie Phest''' was a [[Gender|female]] member of an [[Anomid]] colony that converted to become [[Disciples of the Whills]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]]. In [[1 BBY]], she and several other members of her colony were present in [[Jedha City]] on the [[planet]] [[Jedha]] on the [[Standard day|day]] that the [[city]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]. While she was on Jedha, Phest collected alms for the poor and concealed her body and face behind a [[Color|red]] [[Clothing|robe]] and a [[vocoder mask]] that converted her subvocal harmonics into audible speech.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Silvanie Phest was one of a few [[Anomid]]s that left their [[homeworld]] of [[Yablari]] to become a member of the [[Disciples of the Whills]] on [[Jedha]]. Because her [[species]] lacked vocal cords, Phest used a [[vocoder mask]] to communicate, giving her a delicate, singsong voice.<ref name="GOTW" />

In the time before the [[Galactic Empire]]'s occupation of Jedha, the singing of her prayers at the [[Temple of the Kyber]] would give pause to the [[Guardians of the Whills]].<ref name="GOTW" />

===Age of the Empire===
Sometime prior to the [[destruction of Jedha City]] by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]],<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> Phest and others gathered along the [[Old Shadows]] at the Temple of the Kyber helping those in need. When [[Wernad]] began falsely claiming to be a [[Jedi]] in order to spark a revolt against the Imperial occupation, she feared that this man's claims could result in violence from the [[stormtrooper]]s. Thus, she sought the help of [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]]. Îmwe agreed to help and followed Phest to the Old Shadows, followed by the reluctant Malbus. Phest listened as Îmwe talked with Wernad and joined the Guardian as he sat down prompting Wernard to keep the peace.<ref name="GOTW" />

====Destruction of Jedha City====
Silvanie Phest collected alms for the poor in [[Jedha City]] prior to its destruction. The Imperials regularly searched her and other Anomids on Jedha for fear that fugitives were disguising themselves under their masks.<ref name="ROUVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Silvanie Phest first appeared in the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="RO" /> She was not identified in the film, but received a name in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was released the [[December 16|same day]].<ref name="ROUVG" /> Phest was portrayed by [[Stephanie Silva]] in the film.<ref name="Actor">{{WebCite|url=https://www.mandy.com/actor/profile/stephanie-silva-1#|text=Stephanie Silva, Actor, London - Mandy|archivedate=20190401194744|nolive=1}}</ref> The character's name [[Tuckerization|is similar]] to the actress' name.
